memory_update.text: Add MU as the highest-confidence US-listed direct HBM supplier for the HBM/advanced memory node.
Add TSM as the highest-confidence US-listed ADR for CoWoS/3DFabric advanced packaging capacity control.
Add AMKR as a US-listed OSAT/advanced packaging second-order candidate; evidence is strong for advanced packaging and AI targeting, but revenue specificity to HBM/AI accelerators needs further work.
Add ASML as a second-order HBM capacity enabler through advanced DRAM lithography exposure rather than direct packaging ownership.
Add ONTO as an HBM/advanced packaging process-control and metrology supplier with specific HBM manufacturer order evidence.

Non-US-listed leaders remain important for the node but are outside the US-listed focus: SK hynix, Samsung Electronics, ASE Technology, Ibiden, Shinko, Unimicron, Kinsus, Disco, Besi, ASMPT and ASM International should be tracked in a separate global coverage layer or via OTC/ADR availability checks.

node: HBM, advanced memory, and advanced packaging
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM / advanced memory / advanced packaging node. Highest-confidence direct exposures in this pass are Micron as a US-listed HBM supplier, TSMC as the leading foundry and CoWoS/3DFabric capacity controller, Amkor as a US-listed outsourced advanced packaging and test provider, ASML as a lithography supplier to advanced DRAM/HBM capacity ramps, and Onto Innovation as a process-control/metrology supplier with explicit HBM manufacturer orders. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
